description: Defines builder classes for constructing DL PDCCH and DCI PDUs in a 5G NR protocol stack, including setting parameters for control channels, core sets, and transmission power.

classes.name: dl_dci_pdu_builder
classes.description: Helper class to fill in the DL DCI PDU parameters, including setting UE-specific, control channel, scrambling, power, payload, DMRS, context, and beamforming parameters.

classes.name: dl_pdcch_pdu_builder
classes.description: Helper class to fill in the DL PDCCH PDU parameters, including BWP, coreset, interleaver, non-interleaver, and obtaining DL DCI PDU builder.

methods.name: set_ue_specific_parameters
methods.description: Sets UE-specific parameters for the DL DCI PDU.

methods.name: set_control_channel_parameters
methods.description: Sets control channel parameters for the DL DCI PDU.

methods.name: set_data_scrambling_parameters
methods.description: Sets data scrambling parameters for the DL DCI PDU.

methods.name: set_profile_nr_tx_power_info_parameters
methods.description: Sets profile NR Tx Power info parameters.

methods.name: set_profile_sss_tx_power_info_parameters
methods.description: Sets profile SSS Tx Power info parameters.

methods.name: set_payload
methods.description: Sets the payload of the DL DCI PDU.

methods.name: set_dmrs_parameters
methods.description: Sets DMRS parameters for the DL DCI PDU.

methods.name: get_tx_precoding_and_beamforming_pdu_builder
methods.description: Returns a builder for transmission precoding and beamforming.

methods.name: set_bwp_parameters
methods.description: Sets BWP parameters for the PDCCH PDU.

methods.name: set_coreset_parameters
methods.description: Sets coreset parameters for the PDCCH PDU.

methods.name: set_interleaver_parameters
methods.description: Sets interleaver parameters for the PDCCH PDU.

methods.name: set_non_interleaver_parameters
methods.description: Sets non-interleaver parameters for the PDCCH PDU.

methods.name: get_dl_dci_pdu_builder
methods.description: Gets the DL DCI PDU builder for the PDCCH PDU.
